description: Corpus pointers for feedback_gym. Synthetic demo ships in-repo so the gym runs without muse-eeg-heads on disk.

synthetic.notes: Wake then drowsy regimes; band ratios + relative bands + precomputed AI score columns + drowsy labels.

external.how_to_wire: Point --corpus at an NPZ with the same column schema as demo_session.npz (band_*, delta_rel/theta_rel/alpha_rel/beta_rel, delta_abs, ai_*, labels, cal_n). Sleep-EDF export wiring is a follow-up.
